name: Kofu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with a violet lozenge radiating short rays.
history: The flag of Kofu bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Kofu municipal emblem — a violet lozenge radiating short rays
features.symbolism: the character 甲 in a crystal of the Kai basin
